7593.title: Sidebar resize ignores touch input
7593.rootCauseOneLine: Wide sidebar resizing handles mouse events only; the compact drawer has fixed width and hides the resize handle.

prReviews.verdict: Closed unmerged; static-only review; not executed

7593.proposedFix: Use a consistent pointer-event resize contract and explicitly design compact width persistence, bounds and gesture precedence.
7593.caveats: Source Chromium only; native iOS and packaged desktop not tested. Regression patch and browser script are inline; raw artifacts remain local under public-report policy. No fix PR because a complete migration exceeds the five-file limit.
